title: Referral Activity
summary: Invite your friends and earn bonuses
content:
▍ Rules

  1. The invited person must register through the staff member's referral link to be counted as a valid referral.
  2. You can get your referral link through the Telegram Bot, or contact the recruitment manager to learn how to obtain it.

▍ Rewards

  • Invite a friend to join as Junior Staff → 200 ETB
  • Invite a friend to join as VIP 1 → 600 ETB
  • Invite a friend to join as VIP 2 → 1,870 ETB

▍ Time

July 27 – August 2, 2026 (Ethiopian: Hamle 20 – Hamle 26, 2018 E.C.)

title: Level Upgrade Subsidy Activity
summary: Upgrade to VIP level and receive additional subsidy
content:
▍ Rules

  1. When users upgrade from Junior Staff to VIP 1 or higher, the company provides an additional subsidy.
  2. After the level upgrade, the previous level's deposit will be fully refunded to the user.
  3. On the upgrade day, you can immediately start the new level's tasks and order work.

▍ Rewards

  • Upgrade to VIP 1 or higher → Additional subsidy 600 ETB

▍ Time

July 27 – August 2, 2026 (Ethiopian: Hamle 20 – Hamle 26, 2018 E.C.)

title: Team Fixed Salary & Tax Subsidy
summary: Earn a fixed salary based on the number of VIP members in your team
content:
▍ Rules

  • A fixed salary is paid once per month on the 1st (UTC).
  • After meeting the tax subsidy criteria, you can request a subsidy fund each successful financial cycle.
  • This benefit is permanent — the more members you have, the higher your salary payment.
  • Only VIP level members (VIP 1/2/3) in your team are counted.

▍ Time

Permanent (Long-term)

title: Quiz Competition
summary: Participate every Tuesday, Thursday, and Sunday and win
time: Every Tuesday, Thursday, and Sunday at 7:00 PM UTC+3 | 1:00 PM Habesha Time
content:
▍ Rules

  • Each event includes 10 fun Q&A questions.
  • The first three users to answer correctly can receive a 30 ETB bonus.

▍ How to Claim

After the competition ends, take a screenshot of the winners' list and send it to the recruitment manager to claim your bonus.

▍ Time

Every Tuesday, Thursday, and Sunday at 7:00 PM UTC+3 | 1:00 PM Habesha Time

title: Raffle Ticket Activity
summary: Buy a 20 ETB ticket and win 1,000 ETB
time: Every Saturday at 15:00 (UTC+3) | 9:00 AM Habesha Time
content:
▍ How to Participate

  • Every ticket has a chance to win 1,000 ETB.
  • Each ticket costs 20 ETB.
  • Even if you do not win, the 20 ETB will be refunded after the event ends.

▍ Results Announcement

Winning order numbers will be announced in the group next Saturday at 15:00 (UTC+3) | 9:00 AM Habesha Time.

▍ Ticket Expiration

Raffle tickets have an expiration time. After expiration, funds are automatically refunded to your PG Mall account balance.

▍ Time

Every Saturday at 15:00 (UTC+3) | 9:00 AM Habesha Time
